mapper.sql:
SELECT TS.SERVICE_ID, TS.WORK_CD, TS.CAR_NO, T.CAR_NM, TCD.POST_CAR_NO,
T.REQ_CAR_NO, T.MDF_GB, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(20)) AS TASK_CD, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(30)) AS REQ_CAR_NO, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(10)) AS MDF_GB, T.TASK_CD,
DECODE(T.BOND_YN, 'Y', '일반형', 'PD', '고급형(블랙)', 'PG', '고급형(그레이)', 'PR', '고급형(레드)', 'PB', '고급형(블루)', 'PW', '고급형(화이트)', 'PN', '고급형(네이비)') AS SUBPANNEL, TS.JUDGE_DT AS SORT_DATE, TO_CHAR(TS.JUDGE_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS JUDGE_DT, CASE WHEN TCD.FILENAME6 IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS HAS_OTHER_RETURN_IMAGE, CASE WHEN NI.IMAGE1_PATH IS NOT NULL OR DBMS_LOB.GETLENGTH(NI.IMAGE1) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS IMAGE1_YN, CASE WHEN NI.IMAGE2_PATH IS NOT NULL OR DBMS_LOB.GETLENGTH(NI.IMAGE2) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS IMAGE2_YN, CASE WHEN NI.IMAGE3_PATH IS NOT NULL OR DBMS_LOB.GETLENGTH(NI.IMAGE3) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS IMAGE3_YN, CASE WHEN NI.IMAGE4_PATH IS NOT NULL OR DBMS_LOB.GETLENGTH(NI.IMAGE4) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS IMAGE4_YN, CASE WHEN NI.IMAGE5_PATH IS NOT NULL OR DBMS_LOB.GETLENGTH(NI.IMAGE5) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS IMAGE5_YN, CASE WHEN NI.IMAGE6_PATH IS NOT NULL OR DBMS_LOB.GETLENGTH(NI.IMAGE6) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS IMAGE6_YN FROM TR_SERVICE TS
JOIN TR_MODIFY T ON T.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID JOIN TR_TRNSNAME T ON T.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID
LEFT JOIN TR_CARNO_DETACH TCD ON TCD.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID LEFT JOIN TR_NUMPLATE_IMAGES NI ON NI.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID WHERE TS.WORK_CD = #{WORK_CD} AND TS.PROC_ST NOT IN ('SAV', 'P_REQ', 'B_REQ', 'REQ', 'INPUT', 'C_REQ', 'DEL', 'P_END', 'T_CAN')
AND T.MDF_GB IN ('CARNO', 'BNUM', 'PRPNO')
AND TS.PROC_ST <> 'A_RET' AND (T.NUM_CHANGE_YN = 'Y' OR T.ETC5 = 'Y') AND (T.CARD_YN IS NULL OR T.CARD_YN = 'N' OR (T.CARD_YN = 'Y' AND T.CARD_PAY_YN = 'Y')) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TR_TRNSNAME_SELL S WHERE S.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TR_TRNSNAME_BUY B WHERE B.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID)
AND TS.JUDGE_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DT}, 'YYYYMMDD') AND TS.JUDGE_DT < TO_DATE(#{END_DT}, 'YYYYMMDD') + 1 AND TS.CAR_NO LIKE '%' || #{CAR_NO} || '%' AND (TCD.ETC1 IS NULL OR TCD.ETC1 <> 'Y')
mapper.select: SELECT SERVICE_ID, WORK_CD, CAR_NO, CAR_NM, POST_CAR_NO, REQ_CAR_NO, MDF_GB, TASK_CD, SUBPANNEL, JUDGE_DT, HAS_OTHER_RETURN_IMAGE, IMAGE1_YN, IMAGE2_YN, IMAGE3_YN, IMAGE4_YN, IMAGE5_YN, IMAGE6_YN FROM ( SELECT R.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY R.SORT_DATE, R.SERVICE_ID) AS RN FROM () R ) WHERE RN BETWEEN #{FIRST_ROW} AND #{LAST_ROW} ORDER BY RN
